references.text: The sin offering shall be slaughtered in the same place as the burnt offering, before the Lord's presence. This verse establishes the practice referred to in Leviticus 14:13.
The sin offering shall be slaughtered before the Lord's presence at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered. It is most holy.
The law concerning the guilt offering, which describes that it is most holy and that the priest shall have it, as stated in Leviticus 14:13.
The sin offering and the guilt offering are described as most holy (קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים), the same expression used in Leviticus 14:13.
The burnt offering shall be slaughtered on the north side of the altar before the Lord's presence, referring to the holy place mentioned in Leviticus 14:13.
The preceding verse describing the guilt offering (אָשָׁם) which is brought forward together with the oil.
The slaughter shall take place before the Lord's presence, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, establishing the holy place for offerings.
Ezekiel describes that the sin offering and the guilt offering shall be boiled in the holy area so that it is not carried out to the people and makes them holy.
